description.zh:
是否解绑实例上的所有标签，取值：
* **true**：解绑实例上的所有标签。
* **false**：不解绑实例上的所有标签，默认值。

> 如果同时设置了**TagKey.N**和本参数，则本参数不生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instance. Valid values:

*   **true**: removes all tags from the instance.
*   **false** (default): does not remove all tags from the instance.

> If you specify both this parameter and the **TagKey.N** parameter, this parameter does not take effect.
The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~473763~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
The resource type. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

descriptions.zh:
* 每次解绑的标签数量不能超过20个；
* 标签从一个实例解绑后，如果没有绑定到其它实例，则该标签自动被删除。

该API对应的控制台操作请参见[解绑标签](~~119157~~)。
descriptions.en:
*   You can remove up to 20 tags at a time.
*   If a tag is removed from an instance and is not added to other instances, the tag is deleted.

You can also remove tags from instances in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console. For more information, see [Remove a tag](~~119157~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --all false --resource-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --tag-key demokey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --TagKey.1 demokey --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
